Update (October 7): Apple has released the two RC versions to public beta users, with build numbers identical to the developer RC builds.

In addition to releasing the second public beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, Apple is also rolling out the first release candidates (RCs) for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. Here are the details.

Older versions of macOS continue to receive security updates

As has been the customary practice for minor updates to older versions of macOS, Apple today pushed out the first release candidates for macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 directly, without first seeding a regular beta.

Apple released macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 late last month, each of which went through two RC versions before their official rollout.

The release notes Apple published for the first RCs of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 say only that they "provide important security fixes and are recommended for all users." Last month's updates contained a CoreGraphics security fix, as follows:

Apple is expected to publish details of the fixes included in macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 once those versions are officially released, which is anticipated within the coming weeks alongside macOS 27.2 Golden Gate.

The first macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 RC carries a build number of 24H219, while the first macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RC carries a build number of 25G320.

Have you spotted any new features or changes in today's RC builds? Let us know in the comments.
